mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 3.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns relative to historical mean due to lower cost of capital for firms.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from prior month signals labor market tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL above 205.0 indicates monetary tightening and inflationary pressure, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced real cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL > 205.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, residential housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 110) reflects robust manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through elevated corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units in prior month signals strong consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 1500 and 370000, respectively, indicate robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 370000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, CPIAUCSL above 205.0 indicates inflationary pressure triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced real cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205.0 during monetary tightening (t-test p > 0.05 vs. zero).
